_note: Each raid rolls a THREAT that punishes a missing counter. Coverage (how well your composition answers it) sets the party-wide DANGER. Who actually dies is then a per-unit roll weighted by survivability (see survival block) — frail-first in tendency, never weakest-first by fiat. The haul refills the faucet so the population keeps churning (garden, not unpacking).
_survival_note: Losses are NOT weakest-first. Coverage sets party-wide DANGER (a base death fraction); that danger is redistributed per-unit by survivability so the frail soak most of it — but death_floor means even a champion can get out of position and fall, and death_cap means even a Hollow sometimes scrapes through. Survivability = weighted toughness stats (beef=HP, persistence, wits, speed) + survivability ECHOES (life_drain = life steal keeps you up; frenzy a little). Higher numbers => lower chance, never zero.
